name: EmptyState
description: What to show when a list, table or page has nothing in it yet: a short explanation and the next step.

description.description: One or two sentences on why it is empty and what to do.

icon.description: Optional illustration or icon, shown above the title. Decorative: it is hidden from screen readers.

children.description: Actions, usually one or two Buttons.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the title, 2 to 6.

size.description: sm for inside a card or table, md for a whole page or panel.

requirements: The title is a real heading at the level you choose
The icon is decorative (aria-hidden): the title and description carry the meaning
Actions are ordinary buttons or links in the normal tab order
It is not announced as an alert: it is the page's content, not an interruption
screenReader: Read in order: title, description, then the actions

use_when: A first-run screen, an empty list or a search with no results
Telling people the next step when there is no data
avoid_when: Data that is loading: use Skeleton
anti_patterns: Only a picture with no words
